concerns.text: The plan cites three distinct Hugging Face URLs for QM9 data (lisn519010, hadoan, Hassanharb) but does not specify which column in which file corresponds to 'Merz-Kollman' charges. The standard QM9 release typically contains Mulliken or Hirshfeld charges. If the cited URLs do not contain ESP-derived (MK/RESP) charges, the dataset is inappropriate for the research question (predicting ESP charges), rendering the CPU-only pipeline infeasible as secondary DFT calculation is excluded by constraints.

The plan assumes a 6-hour training window for 10 epochs on a 7 GB RAM CPU runner. While SchNet/DimeNet are CPU-capable, the memory overhead of PyTorch Geometric data structures for 50k-100k molecules (even sampled) combined with the 3D coordinate tensors may exceed the 7 GB limit during batch processing, causing OOM. The plan lacks a specific memory profiling strategy or a fallback sampling rate (e.g., 'if >5GB RAM, reduce to 20k molecules') to guarantee feasibility.
